ability.name: Step 2 - Verify Nmap Presence
ability.description: Proves whether Nmap is available on the path.

stages.command_template: $d='C:\\Windows\\Temp\\bas'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){ni -ItemType Directory -Force $d|out-null}; $(try { $v = nmap --version 2>&1 | Select-String "Nmap"; if ($v) { Write-Output "NMAP_AVAILABLE: true" } else { Write-Output "NMAP_AVAILABLE: false" } } catch { Write-Output "NMAP_AVAILABLE: false" }) | Tee-Object -FilePath $d\step2.txt

rationale: Assesses presence of standard scanning tools to pick the most optimal scan route.
